*Reasoning in my own voice as the farmer:*

Ai-yo, 78 years old now, my back isn't what it used to be. But I've farmed these 5 mu for 40 years — my father farmed them before me. I know every corner. My son works in town at a factory, comes back to help at busy times. My wife helps too, but she's old like me. For the heavy jobs — plowing, harvest — I just pay the tractor man who comes through the village. Everyone does this now. 150 yuan or so for him to come with the combine, saves my bones.

**Wheat first, since that's what's in the ground now going into next cycle.** I always plant wheat around October 10-15. Neighbor Old Zhang plants early but I wait for the soil to cool — same as always. I buy seed from the agricultural shop in town, the regular kind, 济麦 something, I forget the number but the shop owner knows what I want. About 20 jin per mu of seed.

For fertilizer — I use one bag of compound fertilizer (复合肥) per mu before planting, the 15-15-15 kind. That's the base. Then when the wheat turns green in spring, around 清明, I broadcast urea, maybe 20-25 jin per mu. If it looks yellow I put a little more. My neighbor puts more but I don't want to waste money — can't afford to. I've done it this way for many years and get about 800 jin per mu (400 kg). Good enough.

Irrigation — well water. I irrigate before winter (越冬水) to protect the roots, then once in spring at 拔节 (jointing), and once more at 灌浆 (grain filling) if it hasn't rained. The pump costs money, electricity goes up every year, so I don't do extra. Three times usually.

Weeds — I spray once in spring, the 2,4-D type, whatever the shop gives me. Pests — usually only spray if I see 蚜虫 (aphids) on the heads.

**Then maize right after wheat harvest.** Very tight, maybe 3-4 days turnaround. I hire the little planter machine, he sows right into the stubble, no plowing — saves time and money. Hybrid seed, 郑单 or 先玉, whatever my son-in-law tells me is good that year. About 2 jin per mu.

Fertilizer for maize — I topdress urea when it's knee-high (大喇叭口), one bag for the 5 mu, so about 10 kg per mu of urea on top of some compound I put with planting. Less than wheat because maize grows fast in summer heat. Irrigate once or twice if July is dry. Spray once for 玉米螟 (corn borer) if I see holes in leaves.

Harvest maize end of September, combine comes through again. Then back to wheat. Every year the same pattern. I can't afford to gamble on new things — at my age, a bad year is very hard.
